eq-ch06-dwork-template: Exact gravity work in a cell equals minus the rate of change of its potential energy minus the potential-energy flux difference.
eq-ch06-dwork-booked: The booked gravity work is defined from a chosen discrete potential energy, so $E$ plus that energy is conserved.
eq-ch06-dwork-continuity: Discrete $x_1$ continuity: the cell mass tendency is minus the difference of area-weighted total mass fluxes.
eq-ch06-dwork-face: The face form of the gravity work, from potential differences between the centroid and the two faces.
eq-ch06-dwork-faceerr: Error of the face form against the exact work: $O(h^2)$, with two extra curvature terms on spherical-polar grids.
eq-ch06-dwork-pe4: A cell's exact potential energy is $V(\bar\rho\phi - g\sigma^2\partial_1\rho)$ to $O(h^4)$.
eq-ch06-dwork-variance: Variance of $x_1$ about the volume centroid, for Cartesian and spherical-polar cells.
eq-ch06-dwork-slope: The density slope at the centroid from the quadratic through neighbouring cell averages.
eq-ch06-dwork-pe: The corrected discrete potential energy, accurate to $O(h^4)$.
eq-ch06-dwork-d: Corrected-PE gravity work: the face form plus $g\sigma^2$ times the centroid slope of the density tendency.
eq-ch06-dwork-cs: On the cubed sphere, where `x1v` is the face midpoint and not the volume centroid, the corrected potential energy and its work gain the centroid-offset term $g_1\delta\rho$, $\delta = r_c - x_{1v}$.
eq-ch06-dwork-ped-change: Under the corrected scheme, $E + \mathrm{PE}_d$ changes per stage by $g\sum V\sigma^2 s[\Delta\rho]$.
eq-ch06-dwork-order: The corrected gravity work is fourth-order accurate in every cell, wall cells included.
eq-ch06-dwork-uniform: On a uniform Cartesian grid the corrected work is a five-face stencil in the interior and a three-face one at the wall.
eq-ch06-dwork-vicrow: Row $i$ of the vertical implicit block-tridiagonal system, with the stage step $\Delta t_c = w_2\Delta t$.
eq-ch06-dwork-lumped: The end-cell third weight of the centroid slope is lumped onto the neighbour, so the system stays tridiagonal.
eq-ch06-dwork-couple: The implicit energy row gains a coupling to the mass unknowns from the corrected-PE term.
eq-ch06-dwork-energyrow: The implicit solve books, in the energy row, the gravity work of the mass it moves.
eq-ch06-dwork-remainder: After redistribution, the remainder between the full and lumped slopes of the moved mass is added to energy.
